meta.source: storefront-kit brands/postmark (theme.css, catalog.js, supply/postmarks), 16 Oct 2026. Layout, spacing, motion and component tokens start from the Off Duty Hotel Club system, which shares the same storefront.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page ground everywhere: header, sections, modals, the bag drawer. The colour of a good envelope.

tokens.name: stone
tokens.usage: The background of every product photo and the frame behind it, so the image has no visible edge. Also the ground behind postmarks on destination cards.

tokens.name: stone-2
tokens.usage: Hover fill on destination cards and the panel behind the editorial feature.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headlines, body copy, the primary button fill and selected states. Also the frame (announcement bar and footer).

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary copy: product descriptions, intros, accordion bodies. On paper, stone and stone-2.

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Tertiary copy on paper only: result counts, breadcrumbs, the preview note. 4.7:1 on paper; use ink-2 on stone.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline rules between sections and rows. Decorative only, never the sole edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of controls that must be seen: quantity steppers, the email underline. At least 3:1 on paper.

tokens.name: frame
tokens.usage: The page frame only: announcement bar and footer.

tokens.name: on-dark
tokens.usage: Text on the frame.

tokens.name: on-dark-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text on the frame.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Airmail red. Focus rings, errors and the rare emphasis. Never a fill or a large block.

tokens.name: dest-amalfi
tokens.usage: Amalfi cobalt: its postmark, number and colour dot only.

tokens.name: dest-marrakech
tokens.usage: Marrakech terracotta: its postmark, number and colour dot only.

tokens.name: dest-kyoto
tokens.usage: Kyoto indigo: its postmark, number and colour dot only.

tokens.name: dest-mexico-city
tokens.usage: Mexico City pink: its postmark, number and colour dot only.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind drawers and modals.

fonts.source: Google Fonts (bundled as woff2 in storefront-kit supply/postmarks/fonts)

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The hero headline only, once per page. 56px on phones. The second line may be italic; nowhere else uses that pattern.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Section and page titles, product names. 40px on phones. Roman, no full stop, no italic second line.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Modal and drawer titles, the empty-bag line, footer tagline.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Lemons and leaves on cobalt majolica, worn across the body.
styles.usage: All running copy and product names on cards. Measure about 60 characters.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Secondary lines: destination under a product card, accordion bodies, the preview note.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase labels and text links. The smallest size in the system: nothing is set below 12px.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The wordmark only, in spaced capitals. 22px on phones. Barlow Condensed is the postmarks' face; never use it for headings or copy.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a label and the line it labels.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between size buttons; icon to text.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Product card: photo to name.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Minimum side gutter on phones; accordion row padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Grid gap between product cards on desktop; button horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Section heading to content; modal padding.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of a section on phones.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of a section on desktop (the playbook's 100–140px).

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.usage: Side gutter of sections on desktop, capped so content stays within 1500px.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Everything: buttons, cards, photos, inputs, modals. The brand is square-cornered like a printed card.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Only round things: the colour dot and the bag count.

tokens.name: shadow-drawer
tokens.usage: The bag drawer sliding in from the right.

tokens.name: shadow-modal
tokens.usage: Modals: size guide, search, menu. Nothing else casts a shadow.

tokens.name: ease
tokens.usage: Every transition and animation. Nothing bounces or overshoots.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Colour changes on small controls: tabs, thumbnails, size buttons.

tokens.name: duration-slow
tokens.usage: Photo hover scale, front-over-back fade, button darkening, drawer slide.

tokens.name: duration-slower
tokens.usage: Scroll reveals and the hero's first fade. The upper limit.

tokens.name: hover-scale
tokens.usage: Photos on hover. Never applied to buttons, text or cards as a whole.

tokens.name: reveal-distance
tokens.usage: How far a section rises as it fades in on scroll.

tokens.name: focus-width
tokens.usage: Width of the focus outline on every interactive element.

tokens.name: focus-offset
tokens.usage: Gap between the element and its focus outline (2px on thumbnails inside a tight grid).

tokens.name: focus-color
tokens.usage: The outline colour. Passes 3:1 on paper, stone and stone-2; on staff-green use on-dark.

tokens.name: phone
tokens.usage: Below this: single-column forms, full-width drawer, 12px grid gaps.

tokens.name: tablet
tokens.usage: Below this: mobile header and menu, two-column grids, stacked product page.

tokens.name: laptop
tokens.usage: Below this: gallery thumbnails move under the main image.

tokens.name: review-desktop
tokens.usage: Width every page is screenshotted and reviewed at.

tokens.name: review-phone
tokens.usage: Phone width every page is screenshotted and reviewed at.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Widest any content row runs. The gutter grows beyond it.

tokens.name: header-height
tokens.usage: Header bar on desktop; 64px below the tablet breakpoint.

tokens.name: drawer-width
tokens.usage: Bag, search and preview drawers. Full width below the phone breakpoint.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Longest line of running copy.

tokens.name: tap-target
tokens.usage: Smallest height or width of anything that can be pressed.

tokens.name: grid-columns
tokens.usage: Product grid columns on desktop; 2 below the tablet breakpoint. Hotel cards: 4 and 2.

tokens.name: ratio-product
tokens.usage: Every product photo, card, gallery image and thumbnail.

tokens.name: ratio-editorial
tokens.usage: Story and editorial photographs.

tokens.name: ratio-hero
tokens.usage: Hero fills the viewport minus the header. On phones it is cropped with mobileFocus 72% 50% so the strap stays in view.

tokens.name: z-header
tokens.usage: Sticky header.

tokens.name: z-scrim
tokens.usage: Scrim behind drawers and modals.

tokens.name: z-drawer
tokens.usage: Bag, search, menu and preview drawers.

tokens.name: z-skip-link
tokens.usage: Skip link, above everything when focused.

tokens.name: postmark-stroke
tokens.usage: Every ring and wave in the family, in a 340 × 200 box. Never thinner: it has to survive printing on swing tags and boxes.

tokens.name: postmark-min
tokens.usage: Smallest a postmark appears on screen (ring version).

tokens.name: postmark-ink
tokens.usage: A postmark is always one colour: its destination ink on screen, black master for print.
